events.title: Santa's Arrival & Holiday Tree Lighting
events.blurb: Santa arrives on the roof of the Hawthorne Hotel with help from the Salem Fire Department, then leads a procession down the Essex Street mall to light the city's tree at Lappin Park. Gather on Salem Common by 5:45 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Santa llega a la azotea del Hawthorne Hotel con ayuda del Departamento de Bomberos de Salem y luego encabeza un desfile por Essex Street hasta Lappin Park para encender el árbol de la ciudad. Llega a Salem Common antes de las 5:45 p.m.

events.title: Small Business Saturday in Downtown Salem
events.blurb: Salem Main Streets kicks off holiday shopping downtown with deals, pop-ups and activities at local shops starting at 8 a.m.
events.blurbEs: Salem Main Streets inaugura la temporada de compras navideñas en el centro con ofertas, tiendas temporales y actividades en los negocios locales desde las 8 a.m.

events.title: Peabody Essex Museum
events.blurb: Open Friday through Sunday after closing for Thanksgiving, with the Isamu Noguchi exhibition on view and drop-in family art making on weekends. Salem residents and visitors under 16 get in free.
events.blurbEs: Abre de viernes a domingo tras cerrar el Día de Acción de Gracias, con la exposición de Isamu Noguchi y talleres de arte familiares sin cita los fines de semana. Los residentes de Salem y los menores de 16 entran gratis.
events.getThere: Parking at the Museum Place garage on New Liberty Street, the MBTA garage at 252 Bridge Street, or the South Harbor Garage. Salem commuter rail station is about half a mile away.

events.title: Salem Maritime National Historical Park
events.blurb: Walk Derby Wharf any time; the visitor center, Public Stores and Scale House are open 9:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. (the Custom House is closed for the season). All buildings and programs are free.
events.blurbEs: Recorre Derby Wharf a cualquier hora; el centro de visitantes, las Public Stores y la Scale House abren de 9:30 a.m. a 4:30 p.m. (la Custom House está cerrada por temporada). Todos los edificios y programas son gratis.

events.title: Darlene Love: Love for the Holidays
events.blurb: The Rock & Roll Hall of Famer known as the Queen of Christmas brings her holiday tour to Beverly. Doors at 7 p.m.
events.blurbEs: La integrante del Salón de la Fama del Rock & Roll, conocida como la Reina de la Navidad, trae su gira navideña a Beverly. Puertas a las 7 p.m.

events.title: The Last Waltz: A North Shore Celebration
events.blurb: North Shore bands including Dead to the Core, Skunk Sessions and Cold Engines mark 50 years of The Band's farewell concert, with donations collected for Lifebridge North Shore.
events.blurbEs: Bandas del North Shore como Dead to the Core, Skunk Sessions y Cold Engines celebran 50 años del concierto de despedida de The Band, con donaciones para Lifebridge North Shore.

events.title: Beverly Holiday Pops Concert
events.blurb: The 35-piece Hillyer Festival Orchestra plays Beverly's first Holiday Pops, with sing-alongs and a visit from Santa. Doors and bar open at 6 p.m.
events.blurbEs: La Hillyer Festival Orchestra, de 35 músicos, ofrece el primer Holiday Pops de Beverly, con canciones para cantar en grupo y una visita de Santa. Puertas y bar abren a las 6 p.m.

events.title: Beverly Holiday Parade
events.blurb: This year's parade, themed "Celebrating 400 Years of Beverly," steps off from Beverly High School and runs about 1.7 miles down Cabot Street to Beverly Depot. Rain date is Dec. 6.
events.blurbEs: El desfile de este año, con el tema "Celebrating 400 Years of Beverly", sale de Beverly High School y recorre unas 1.7 millas por Cabot Street hasta Beverly Depot. Si llueve, se pasa al 6 de diciembre.

events.title: The Temptations
events.blurb: Founding member Otis Williams leads the Motown group behind "My Girl" and "Get Ready." Doors at 6 p.m.
events.blurbEs: El miembro fundador Otis Williams encabeza el grupo de Motown de "My Girl" y "Get Ready". Puertas a las 6 p.m.
